title: USS Liberty: Copy of CTF69 Message 061140Z JUN67

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I am a survivor of the June 8, 1967 Israeli attack on the USS Liberty (AGTR-5) and serve my shipmates as Vice President and Historian of the USS Liberty Veterans Association (https://ussliberty.org).

I am requesting a copy of CTF69 Message 061140Z JUN67.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Joe Meadors

communications.subject: Minnesota Government Data Practices Act Request: SPPD UAS/DDP Drone Flights
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

Flight log data for every Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) drone flight from 01/01/2023 to the data of this request including the following data points: date, time, duration, Case ID/Case Number, MN 626.19 Purpose, Incident Type, Incident, Block, Police Grid Number, Neighborhood Name, Block, Call Disposition. Please provide this information in spreadsheet format. 

Flight log data for every Docked Drone Program (DDP) drone flight from 01/01/2023 to the data of this request including the following data points: date, time, duration, Case ID/Case Number, MN 626.19 Purpose, Incident Type, Incident, Block, Police Grid Number, Neighborhood Name, Block, Call Disposition. Please provide this information in spreadsheet format.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Eyes Off Saint Paul
